name: 90806 · Long Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 90806 (Long Beach) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90806 (Long Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90806 (Long Beach) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
